practice.website_identity: patient-facing practice microsite hosted on the GTD domain; no separate live public practice domain found during this pass

investigation.method: manual review of live practice pages with NHS profile and search-result cross-checks

headline: City Health Centre looks like a cleaner GTD-managed site: the website platform is GTD's Concrete CMS stack and the live online request route presented to patients is Accurx, with different availability windows for urgent/medical versus routine/admin use of the same form.

live_stack.label: Patient-facing website stack
live_stack.platform: GTD-hosted practice microsite on concrete5 / Concrete CMS
evidence: The page exposes a concrete5 - 8.5.1 generator tag.
The whole site lives under gtdhealthcare.co.uk/cityhealthcentre.
Search and NHS-profile checks did not surface a separate live practice domain; this GTD URL appears to be the patient-facing microsite.

live_stack.label: Current online request platform
evidence: The appointments page links directly to https://accurx.nhs.uk/patient-initiated/y02849.
The same Accurx route is presented for both health problems and routine/admin requests.

current_routes.label: Accurx request form for health problems
notes: The site says this route is available Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 12pm for health problems and may close earlier at high demand.
The page says all such requests are reviewed by a GP the same working day.

current_routes.label: Accurx request form for routine/admin requests
notes: The same Accurx route is also described as available Monday to Friday, 7:30am to 6:30pm for routine care and admin requests.
The site says those requests are usually reviewed within one to two working days.

current_routes.label: Phone route
notes: The appointments page says patients can call 0161 839 6227 as an alternative to the online form.
Do not over-read this as a separate booking platform.

current_routes.label: Cancellation routes
notes: The site says patients can cancel via NHS account, by phone, or by visiting reception.

current_routes.label: Prescriptions
notes: The prescriptions page points patients to their NHS account or to the practice email address gmicb-mh.cityhealthcentre@nhs.net.

complaints_and_feedback.headline: Complaints information is present and more current than New Bank's site.

items.label: Complaints via contact-us page
notes: The contact page says patients should raise concerns with the practice manager first or contact the complaints team directly.
It lists practice and GTD complaints contact details, including gtd.feedback@nhs.net.

stale_or_conflicting_signals.label: No standalone complaints page where the URL suggests one might exist
notes: A guessed complaints-and-compliments page path returns 404; the complaints route is embedded in contact-us instead.

probably_true: Accurx is the current patient-facing request platform here.
This site distinguishes clinical/urgent-style demand from routine/admin demand more clearly than New Bank.
needs_follow_up: Whether the same Accurx form branches internally for health-problem versus admin use, or whether the distinction is only in the website instructions.
